description: Call when check, require, prove and claim_identity are not the job: verify a credential someone shows you, the published standard and its gates, the public log and receipts, linking your identifiers, agreements that settle on proof, watching a counterparty. Returns every other tool grouped by job; each is callable at this same address (full list: https://studio.mizan.market/mcp/full). more("problems") gives the problems MIZAN solves. Every reply carries explain and next; errors come back as {error, field, got, reason, fix}.
